title: Mom Goes Through Menopause
synopsis: Little Liu and her dad navigate how to help their mother, who is experiencing various symptoms of menopause.

fullText.simplified:
老妈到了更年期

    小刘一直觉得自己有个非常幸福的家庭：父母恩爱，自己与父母的关系不错，家庭氛围和谐。可是，最近小刘却非常烦恼，因为她妈妈进入了更年期，家里被妈妈搞得鸡犬不宁，就连家里的宠物狗看见妈妈都躲着走。这不，她老妈又来“找茬”了。
    “哎呀，你们怎么回事呀？我刚收拾完的屋子，不到五分钟就被你们弄成了这个鬼样子！走走走，都给我出去，别在家里烦我！”小刘看了看爸爸，小声对他说：“这是我妈今天第三十八次大吼了，老爸快走！千万别再惹我妈了！”说完，小刘和爸爸快速穿上鞋，逃出了家门。出门的时候，小刘妈妈还在不停地数落小刘和她爸爸，说小刘不懂事，整天就知道花钱买买买；嫌小刘爸爸懒，天天出去下棋，家里什么事儿都不管。
    到了楼下，小刘爸爸拍了拍小刘的肩膀说：“别放在心上，你妈现在更年期，情绪波动大，她自己控制不了。我们需要理解她。”小刘点了点头，就这样父女俩在小区旁边的公园里转了一圈又一圈。过了两个小时，他们觉得小刘妈妈消气了，才回了家。
    一进门，他们就看见小刘妈妈躺在沙发上，哎呦哎呦地喊着不舒服。小刘赶紧跑过去问：“妈，您哪儿不舒服呀？”小刘妈妈说：“我心脏难受，喘不上来气，头也觉得有点儿晕，腰酸背疼，浑身上下都不舒服。”小刘爸爸说：“来来来，我帮你按摩按摩，然后再给你沏个菊花茶，降降火。”小刘妈妈说：“这还差不多，你们父女俩，一点儿都不关心我，我天天累得要死，你们却跑出去躲清静。我容易吗，一个人负责一家子的事儿，洗衣做饭收拾屋子，你们就不能理解我一下吗？”……接下来的五十分钟，小刘妈妈一直在说说说，小刘父女只能在旁边不停点头说：“对对对，是是是，你说得都对，我们改！”
    小刘和她爸爸在对待小刘妈妈更年期这件事上做得非常棒。他们知道换位思考，努力帮助小刘妈妈调整。如果你身边也有像小刘妈妈一样的妈妈，千万别着急，对她们多一点耐心。因为进入更年期的女人，她们往往情绪波动大、失眠、身体出现许多小问题，而且经常疑神疑鬼的，怀疑自己得了重病。这个时候，家人的理解对她们来说是良药，多带她们出去走走，多沟通交流，共同帮助她们度过更年期这个难关。
fullText.traditional:
老媽到了更年期

    小劉一直覺得自己有個非常幸福的家庭：父母恩愛，自己與父母的關係不錯，家庭氛圍和諧。可是，最近小劉卻非常煩惱，因為她媽媽進入了更年期，家裡被媽媽搞得雞犬不寧，就連家裡的寵物狗看見媽媽都躲著走。這不，她老媽又來“找茬”了。
    “哎呀，你們怎麼回事呀？我剛收拾完的屋子，不到五分鐘就被你們弄成了這個鬼樣子！走走走，都給我出去，別在家裡煩我！”小劉看了看爸爸，小聲對他說：“這是我媽今天第三十八次大吼了，老爸快走！千萬別再惹我媽了！”說完，小劉和爸爸快速穿上鞋，逃出了家門。出門的時候，小劉媽媽還在不停地數落小劉和她爸爸，說小劉不懂事，整天就知道花錢買買買；嫌小劉爸爸懶，天天出去下棋，家裡什麼事兒都不管。
    到了樓下，小劉爸爸拍了拍小劉的肩膀說：“別放在心上，你媽現在更年期，情緒波動大，她自己控制不了。我們需要理解她。”小劉點了點頭，就這樣父女倆在小區旁邊的公園裡轉了一圈又一圈。過了兩個小時，他們覺得小劉媽媽消氣了，才回了家。
    一進門，他們就看見小劉媽媽躺在沙發上，哎呦哎呦地喊著不舒服。小劉趕緊跑過去問：“媽，您哪兒不舒服呀？”小劉媽媽說：“我心臟難受，喘不上來氣，頭也覺得有點兒暈，腰酸背疼，渾身上下都不舒服。”小劉爸爸說：“來來來，我幫你按摩按摩，然後再給你沏個菊花茶，降降火。”小劉媽媽說：“這還差不多，你們父女倆，一點兒都不關心我，我天天累得要死，你們卻跑出去躲清靜。我容易嗎，一個人負責一家子的事兒，洗衣做飯收拾屋子，你們就不能理解我一下嗎？”……接下來的五十分鐘，小劉媽媽一直在說說說，小劉父女只能在旁邊不停點頭說：“對對對，是是是，你說得都對，我們改！”
    小劉和她爸爸在對待小劉媽媽更年期這件事上做得非常棒。他們知道換位思考，努力幫助小劉媽媽調整。如果你身邊也有像小劉媽媽一樣的媽媽，千萬別著急，對她們多一點耐心。因為進入更年期的女人，她們往往情緒波動大、失眠、身體出現許多小問題，而且經常疑神疑鬼的，懷疑自己得了重病。這個時候，家人的理解對她們來說是良藥，多帶她們出去走走，多溝通交流，共同幫助她們度過更年期這個難關。

sentences.traditional: 如果你身邊也有像小劉媽媽一樣的媽媽，千萬別著急，對她們多一點耐心。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ shēn biān yě yǒu xiàng xiǎo liú mā ma yí yàng de mā ma qiān wàn bié zháo jí duì tā men duō yì diǎn nài xīn
sentences.english: They knew how to put themselves in her shoes and tried their best to help Little Liu’s mom adjust.

sentences.simplified: 因为进入更年期的女人，她们往往情绪波动大、失眠、身体出现许多小问题，
sentences.traditional: 因為進入更年期的女人，她們往往情緒波動大、失眠、身體出現許多小問題，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi jìn rù gēng nián qī de nǚ rén tā men wǎng wǎng qíng xù bō dòng dà shī mián shēn tǐ chū xiàn xǔ duō xiǎo wèn tí
sentences.english: If you have a mom like Little Liu’s mom around you, remember, don’t worry, just be patient with them.

sentences.simplified: 而且经常疑神疑鬼的，怀疑自己得了重病。
sentences.traditional: 而且經常疑神疑鬼的，懷疑自己得了重病。
sentences.pinyin: ér qiě jīng cháng yí shén yí guǐ de huái yí zì jǐ dé le zhòng bìng
sentences.english: This is because women entering menopause often have large mood swings, insomnia, and many small physical problems.

sentences.simplified: 这个时候，家人的理解对她们来说是良药，
sentences.traditional: 這個時候，家人的理解對她們來說是良藥，
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shí hou jiā rén de lǐ jiě duì tā men lái shuō shì liáng yào
sentences.english: They are also often paranoid and suspect that they have become seriously ill.

sentences.simplified: 多带她们出去走走，多沟通交流，共同帮助她们度过更年期这个难关。
sentences.traditional: 多帶她們出去走走，多溝通交流，共同幫助她們度過更年期這個難關。
sentences.pinyin: duō dài tā men chū qù zǒu zǒu duō gōu tōng jiāo liú gòng tóng bāng zhù tā men dù guò gēng nián qī zhè ge nán guān
sentences.english: In these times, the understanding of family members is good medicine for them.

sentence_translations: Mom Goes Through Menopause
Little Liu always thought she had a very happy family:
Her parents have a loving relationship, she has a good relationship with her parents, and the family atmosphere is harmonious.
However, recently Little Liu has been distressed because her mother has entered menopause.
The family is often nervous because of her mom, and even their pet dog avoids her when he sees her.
Look, her mom has come to “pick faults” again.
“Ah, what is going on with you guys?
I just cleaned up the house, and in less than five minutes, you have turned it into this mess!
Go, go, go, get out, don’t annoy me here in the house!”
Little Liu looked at her dad and whispered to him, “This is the 38th time my mom has yelled today.”
Dad, let’s get out of here. We don’t want to aggravate my mom again!”
After saying this, Little Liu and her dad quickly put on their shoes and escaped from the house.
As they were leaving, Little Liu’s mom was still incessantly criticizing Little Liu and her dad.
She was saying that Little Liu was immature and only knew how to spend money buying things.
She complained that Little Liu’s dad was lazy and went out to play chess every day, not taking care of anything around the house.
When they got downstairs, Little Liu’s dad patted her on the shoulder and said, ..
.. “Don’t take it to heart. Your mom is in menopause. She has mood swings that she can’t control.
We need to understand where she’s coming from.”
Little Liu nodded, and so father and daughter walked round and round the park next to their apartment complex.
After two hours had passed, they felt that Little Liu’s mom had probably calmed down, so they returned home.
As soon as they entered the door, they saw Little Liu’s mom lying down on the couch, groaning in discomfort.
Little Liu rushed over to ask, “Mom, what’s wrong?”
Little Liu’s mom said, “My heart doesn’t feel good, I can’t catch my breath, my head is a little dizzy too, and my waist and back hurt.
My whole body is uncomfortable.”
Little Liu’s dad said, “Here, I’ll give you a massage, then I’ll make some chrysanthemum tea to help cool you down.”
Little Liu’s mom said, “That’s more like it. You two don’t care about me at all.
I’m exhausted every day, yet you went out for peace and quiet.
Do you think that I have it easy? I am the one responsible for taking care of everything in this household.
I do the laundry, cook, and clean. Can’t you just try to understand where I’m coming from?”
For the next 50 minutes, Little Liu’s mother kept on talking and talking.
Little Liu and her father could only look on and nod continuously, saying, ..
… “Correct, yes, yes, yes. You are absolutely right. We will make changes!”
Little Liu and her dad did a great job handling Little Liu’s mom going through menopause.
They knew how to put themselves in her shoes and tried their best to help Little Liu’s mom adjust.
If you have a mom like Little Liu’s mom around you, remember, don’t worry, just be patient with them.
This is because women entering menopause often have large mood swings, insomnia, and many small physical problems.
They are also often paranoid and suspect that they have become seriously ill.
In these times, the understanding of family members is good medicine for them.
Take them out more and communicate with them more. Together, help them get through the difficult time of menopause.
